name: a world that stays
describe: No rounds: one shared place, saved on the play host, that players drop in and out of; no clock, no score, no bots, no results.
pick: nothing ends and nobody wins: people come back to what they left (a block sandbox, a hangout)

needs.why: today's world is the voxel island with the build mechanic

promise: The world keeps what we built when we come back, and friends who join see it.

evidence.what: a block world passes verify-world 24 of 24
